title: Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) Accounts Receivable Policy: Due Dates, Payments, Late Fees and Suspension
content:
**1. Due date.** A Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) invoice falls due the plan's net terms, in calendar days, after it is posted.

**2. Applying payments.** A payment is applied to the invoice its remittance names. If the remittance names no invoice, the payment goes to the oldest open invoice first, with one entry per invoice applied. Card payments are accepted only for an invoice whose total does not exceed the plan's card payment limit.

**3. Former late fee clause, no longer in force for every invoice.** This clause is no longer in force as a rule for every invoice: "On the first day of each calendar month every invoice still unpaid more than the grace period in calendar days after its due date is assessed one late fee of the plan's monthly late fee percentage of its unpaid balance, or the plan's minimum late fee if greater, rounded half up to the cent."

- The cycle invoice of a subscription billed annually has its own late charge schedule. That schedule applies on the first day of each calendar month once the invoice is still unpaid more than the grace period after its due date.
- Every other invoice is still assessed one late fee on the first day of each calendar month on which it is still unpaid more than the grace period in calendar days after its due date. The fee is the plan's monthly late fee percentage of its unpaid balance, or the plan's minimum late fee if greater, rounded half up to the cent.

**4. Suspension.** A subscription may be suspended once the oldest unpaid invoice on it is past due by the plan's suspension threshold in days. Because the commitment keeps being charged while suspended, cycle charges continue to be invoiced during suspension and the commitment is not reduced.

**5. Reactivation.** The subscription is reactivated once every past-due invoice on it is paid in full.

## Late fee on an invoice other than an annual cycle invoice (hypothetical figures)

Take a monthly invoice still unpaid past the grace period, with an unpaid balance of 1000.00 USD, a 1.5 percent monthly rate and a 25.00 USD minimum. The percentage amount is 15.00, so the minimum of 25.00 applies. On an unpaid balance of 4000.00 USD, the percentage amount of 60.00 applies instead.

## Payment application (hypothetical)

A remittance of 500.00 USD that names no invoice is applied to the oldest open invoice first. Any remainder goes to the next oldest invoice, with one entry for each invoice it reaches.
